summary: Operation-key and registry layer for relations, the relations analog of expression function keys. Defines RKEY_SUBSTRAIT_REL and RKEY_MOUNTAINASH_REL enums, MountainashRelExtension URIs, RelationOperationDef/ArgBinding/ArgKind, the class-level RelationOperationRegistry populated by register_all_relation_operations, and handler-routed visit functions (join, join_asof, ref, resource_read, source, conform). Also owns backends/relation_systems/base.py (BaseRelationSystem) and resource_files.py (shared resource-file parsing and schema inspection).
key_classes: RKEY_SUBSTRAIT_REL — Substrait-namespace operation keys (READ, FILTER, JOIN, AGGREGATE, ...)
RKEY_MOUNTAINASH_REL — extension keys (DROP_NULLS, SAMPLE, PIVOT, CONFORM, JOIN_ASOF, IMPORT_INTO, ...)
RelationOperationDef — declarative definition of a relation operation
RelationOperationRegistry — class-level singleton mapping key to definition
key_functions: visit_join / visit_join_asof / visit_ref / visit_resource_read / visit_source / visit_conform — handler-routed operations (handlers.py)
classify_relation_def(d) — classify a def as protocol- vs handler-routed
parse_resource_to_arrow(resource, *, dialect) / inspect_resource_schema(...) — resource file reading (resource_files.py)
confined_local_paths(resource, *, tree) — path confinement for resource reads
extension_points: RKEY enums: add key then definition then protocol then backends (adding-operations principle)
